string-array.name: quotes
string-array.item: You picked up your phone again. What were you hoping to find?
Nobody is coming to save you. That\'s the good news.
The life you keep postponing is the one you\'re living.
You\'re not behind. You\'re watching everyone else\'s highlight reel.
Discipline is just remembering what you want.
Your parents are getting older while you scroll.
Most of what you fear will never happen. Some of it already did, and you survived.
Comfort is a slow way to disappear.
You don\'t need more time. You need fewer distractions.
Be the person your younger self needed.
Tired of starting over? Stop quitting.
The people who love you don\'t need you to be impressive.
One day you\'ll wish you had called them back.
You can\'t hate yourself into someone you love.
The feed is infinite. Your life isn\'t.
Hard choices, easy life. Easy choices, hard life.
You already know what you should be doing.
Feelings are visitors. Let them come, let them go.
Nobody remembers your mistakes as much as you do.
Small steps still move you. Standing still doesn\'t.
Someone out there would trade everything for your ordinary day.
You are allowed to outgrow people.
Rest is not a reward. It\'s part of the work.
You are not your worst day.
Say the thing. Life is short and people are waiting.
If it costs you your peace, it\'s too expensive.
The version of you that wins is boring: sleep, water, work, repeat.
You are one decision away from a different year.
Stop waiting for motivation. It shows up after you start.
No one thinks about you as much as you fear. Be free.
Grief is love with nowhere to go.
Look up. This moment won\'t come again.
You won\'t find yourself in someone else\'s life.
Every expert was once a disaster.
What you do daily says more than what you\'ll do someday.
Silence is also an answer.
Some doors close so you stop knocking.
You\'re not lazy. You\'re scared. Start anyway.
Kindness costs nothing, and you still ration it.
Forgive yourself. You didn\'t know then what you know now.
Ten minutes of doing beats ten hours of planning.
They left. You stayed. That counts.
Nothing changes if nothing changes.
Same 24 hours as everyone. Where did today\'s go?
The dream doesn\'t care how you feel this morning.
Be gentle. Everyone is fighting something you can\'t see.
You\'re not too old. You\'re scared of being a beginner.
Loneliness is a message, not a verdict.
Your future self is watching. Give them something to thank you for.
Stop explaining yourself to people committed to misunderstanding you.
Breathe. You have survived every hard day so far.
Not every thought deserves your attention.
The mountain doesn\'t care about your excuses.
If today were the last, would it have been enough?
Love is a verb. Show up.
You can be grateful and still want more.
Pain is information. Suffering is the story you keep telling about it.
Don\'t trade what you want most for what you want now.
There is no later. There is only now, pretending.
Nobody on their deathbed wished for more screen time.
Whatever you\'re avoiding is where the growth is.
Being busy is not the same as being alive.
The people you ignore today become memories tomorrow.
You are the sum of your mornings.
It\'s okay to not be okay. It\'s not okay to live there.
Your worth isn\'t counted in likes.
Talk to yourself like someone you love.
Start before you\'re ready. Nobody ever is.
You keep asking for a sign. This is one.
Mercy for others starts with mercy for yourself.
Unfinished things weigh more than finished ones.
The world needs your work, not your worry.
Your mother\'s voice won\'t always be one call away.
The day already started. Are you in it?
Hope is a decision, not a feeling.
What would you do today if you weren\'t afraid?
Put this down. Go outside. The sky is free.
Every \"not now\" becomes \"never\" if you let it.
Don\'t spend today on things that don\'t love you back.
You are still here. Act like it matters, because it does.
